feeds.title: ModernFilipina.ph
feeds.description: ModernFilipina.ph is an online magazine whose aim is to empower Filipino women. We want to help Filipinas achieve their personal and career goals to become and stay healthy, happy, and fulfilled. To do this, we regularly share tips on health and wellness, careers and money, fashion and beauty, and relationships. We also showcase profiles and interviews with inspiring modern Filipinas and feature products and experiences to try.

feeds.title: Project Vanity
feeds.description: Project Vanity is the Philippine's top beauty website, written by a team of passionate beauty mavens. Find reviews, tutorials, and videos!

feeds.title: Dear Kitty Kittie Kath
feeds.description: Top Lifestyle, Beauty and Mommy Blog on Skincare, Makeup, Health, Fitness, Parenting, Fashion, Tech, Food, and Travel in the Philippines.

feeds.title: Pinay Ads
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Iris Acosta! Welcome to Pinay Ads, a lifestyle blog that was founded in August 2008. If you are a SAHM (Stay At Home Mom and wife), we might share the same interest and experiences, too! Topics posted here include my curiosity on the latest and hottest entertainment news, technology trends, travel tips, food (anything about it), family and relationships, as well as, parenting, among others. So if you are into random but interesting and useful topics, you've come to the right place!

feeds.title: Mommy Practicality
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog! I write about my practical life as a mother of three talented and handsome boys, as an ex-single mom and now a happily married woman to my long-time best friend and soulmate, as a former corporate marketing specialist, and as a life adventurer! Welcome to Mommy Practicality!

feeds.title: Mommy Ginger
feeds.description: Mommy Ginger is a blog, owned by Ginger Arboleda, a mom and an entrepreneur. She writes about business, marketing, start-ups and mommyhood. For anyone who wants to learn how to manage time, how to learn about business by reading or viewing experiences from others, this is the blog to follow!

feeds.title: Bride and Breakfast
feeds.description: Bride and Breakfast is a wedding resource committed to style, taste, and beauty. We feature only the most stylish, gorgeous and magazine-worthy weddings in the Metro, tapping the crème-de-la-crème of wedding suppliers, and showcasing inspiring ideas that can help make your wedding fashionably chic and character-filled.

feeds.title: Kikay Runner
feeds.description: Kikay Runner is one of the Philippines' top websites about running, off-road races, and triathlons. Authored by Noelle De Guzman, a female recreational runner who likes looking good while running fast.

feeds.title: SavingsPinay Blog
feeds.description: SavingsPinay is a personal finance blog of a common Pinay. This blog promotes financial literacy for the young and young at heart by providing insights and tips on budgeting, saving, investing and online entrepreneurship. Set to be the #1 Personal Finance Blog in the Philippines, SavingsPinay guarantees quality posts every Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday!

feeds.title: Love, Teacher Angel
feeds.description: Teacher Angel is a Teacher, Blogger, and Financial Coach that aims to spread love, insights, and inspiration. One post at a time, she also wants to shed light on mental health.

feeds.title: The Lifestyle Avenue
feeds.description: The Lifestyle Avenue offers a diverse exploration of topics ranging from travel to entertainment, food, and family life. With an approachable and warm tone, the blog shares personal experiences, recommendations, and reviews that cover all aspects of modern living. Whether it's tips for the best family getaways or insights into pop culture, the posts resonate with those seeking a balanced, joyful lifestyle.

feeds.title: Female Network
feeds.description: Female Network is the first Philippine website for women. To help her go beyond what others have settled for, Female Network provides her with the necessary tools to help her live her life on her own terms. We offer practical career and financial guides to assist in her decision-making, love advice for when she has no one to turn to, sensible fashion and beauty tips so she can look her best, unconventional travel ideas for that well-deserved vacation, and stories of and by real women to inspire her when she feels stuck.

feeds.title: Musings and Pathways
feeds.description: Musings and Pathways is a personal blog of Gel, a Filipina, a wanderer and writer. I started this blog in 2010 as a requirement for our online journalism class. Since then, it has evolved into a platform for me to share my thoughts on love and life and aspirations that have kept me going amidst some setbacks that I have gone through.
